svg.title: Ashvena Kadi Patta Cashews - wrap label

g.text: Since 1953, Ashvena has roasted cashews the
slow way. Our Kadi Patta Cashews are
inspired by the classic South Indian tadka.
Whole W240 kernels are roasted golden, then
tempered with crackling mustard seeds, fresh
curry leaves and a gentle hint of green
(tree nut). Made in a facility that
also handles peanuts, other tree nuts
Store in a cool, dry place away
